latency_definition: wall time of each verification block, including lookup, synchronized decoding, greedy selection and rollback; multiple tokens in a speculative block arrive together
task_scoring: Existing qualification scorer normalizes case and trailing punctuation, strips thinking/fences, and parses JSON; literal matching is additionally reported. Complete code equality remains literal after outer whitespace trimming.
note: p95 block equals token latency only where every block contains one token; telemetry includes initialization, prefill and excluded runs.
